classification: Author mathematical and implementation review; no independent reviewer
analytic_checks: Product weights grouped by distinct integer product, not counted once per factorization. Arbitrary signed pair weights realize arbitrary grouped weights.
Direct products and divisor-completed products are distinct spaces and are not assumed nested.
NS86 prescribed new block belongs to the free divisor lift; its old 2c term is absorbed by the refit.
For p>N, no product seed contains p, while all divisors of m<N are available. This proves the exact mp constraint.
All-residual obstruction explicitly assumes a pair of primes in the block; no unproved prime asymptotic is used. Constructed residual is not the target residual.
Indefinite minor is for direct product pairings, not H or the divisor-completed pairing matrix; zero diagonal follows from the normal equation at 4 for N>=4.
Loss lower bound uses the dual H inverse norm of the coefficient constraint; it lower-bounds discarded gain, not retained gain.
The complete gain split includes every cross term and old-space projection. No finite support in physical space is assumed.
Restricted lower gain would suffice but is not asserted necessary or equivalent to the full PR42 target.
NS87 cutoff N^6 remains sufficient for joint tails; M=N^2 is not called a sufficient physical cutoff.
Free reweighting and old refit generally lose the prescribed defect-convolution square; no positivity or contraction is deduced from that identity.
Finite gain over 50 percent at N16 is compatible with the asymptotic critical-zero restriction; no onset or eventual fraction is asserted.
implementation_checks: Exact fmpq row reduction selects linearly independent columns before the Arb solve.
Both old and new solves preserve full balls; complete Gram kernel analytic tails are retained.
Separate full-size solve overlaps the Schur-complement full gain.
Complete coefficient fit recomputed from old projection reproduces the trial norm.
Missing gain independently computed from the residual observation vector.
Physical code evaluates exact cells and the exterior plus complete Stirling tail, independent of the Gram assembly.
All source/input/dependency bindings checked, 256/384 and doubled-cutoff overlaps pass.
Saved coefficients are enclosures of an exact fit, not an asserted exact rounded rational witness.
development_corrections: Maxima initially simplified a one-by-one matrix to a scalar before index extraction. Set scalarmatrixp:false explicitly and reran all 18 checks successfully.
The first diagnostic import check ran before the new local module path was added. Configured the actual evidence directory and reran; zero diagnostics.
Clarified inherited contraction summary as every sufficiently large doubling, and corrected stale current-manifest link forward.
what_had_to_change: Free the signed divisor-product weights and refit the old coefficients; retain complementary directions and abandon the prescribed defect-square identity for that fit.
obstruction: The arithmetic product algebra gives a restricted variational space, not an independent lower bound on its actual-target signed observation energy. Its uniform all-residual comparison fails under the explicit prime-pair hypothesis.
bound_or_object: Failure of that comparison and of a direct product-pairing positivity shortcut; no failure of the actual-target convergence estimate or RH. Finite free-fit performance is favorable.
